summary: Add repeatable interactive Explorer setup for node connection, ingress and faucet policy
details: Add usdb-explorer setup with current-setting defaults, input validation and a final review before atomically saving a private source configuration and its backup.
Cover local and external RPC, bundled or external Nginx, visitor URLs independent of host ports, existing HTTPS certificates, and optional faucet amounts and limits without collecting miner keys.
Preserve deployment identity, reference endpoints, samples and existing faucet policy; recover defaults from a verified prepared deployment if the source configuration is missing.
Leave services and prepared files unchanged, print path-specific prepare and lifecycle commands, and guide newly installed operators to setup. Noninteractive configure commands remain supported.
operator_actions: After upgrading the tool, run usdb-explorer setup to configure or revise settings; apply saved changes using the printed prepare and lifecycle commands.
Provide existing certificates for bundled HTTPS or apply the generated private route snippet in external Nginx. Fund an enabled faucet separately after startup.
